Step 1: Start date is 1186-12-07 (assuming DD-MM-YYYY format given as 07-12-1186).  
Step 2: 24 weeks = 24 × 7 = 168 days. Add 4 days → total subtract 172 days.  
Step 3: 1186-12-07 minus 172 days:  
December 7 → back 7 days to Nov 30.  
Remaining 165 days: November has 30 days, so back to Nov 0 means Oct 31 (1 day), then 164 days left.  
Go back through months of 1186: Oct (31), Sep (30), Aug (31), Jul (31), Jun (30), May (31) → total days subtracted = 7 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31 = 191 days from Dec 7, which overshoots. Let’s compute directly:  

Better: Count days from start of year 1186 to Dec 7: Jan 31 + Feb 28 (1186 not leap, not divisible by 4 in Gregorian) + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 + Jun 30 + Jul 31 + Aug 31 + Sep 30 + Oct 31 + Nov 30 + Dec 7 = 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+30+31+30+7 = 341st day of year.  

Subtract 172 days from day 341: 341 − 172 = 169th day of year 1186.  

169th day: Jan 31 (31), Feb 28 (59), Mar 31 (90), Apr 30 (120), May 31 (151), Jun 30 (181) → so 169 is in June: 151 days done by May 31, so June 1 = day 152, June 18 = day 152+17 = day 169.  

Thus new date: 1186-06-18.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1186-06-18
